name: Hidden Palace of Lianshan Formula
description: The operation of the Lianshan Formula created endless thunderstorms within the bowels of the mountain. It is said that the rumbling sounds of thunder that one hears outside the domain's gates call out to curious souls.

tabs.name: Domain of Forgery: Thundercloud Altar I
tabs.description:
Massive Electro energy is coursing through this thundering ancient sacrificial altar.
You shall earn Weapon Ascension Materials, if — and only if — you can pass the trial.
